messages.subject: adding cross information to cross_info file  - CC mice panel
parts:
Hi, 

I have the files of CC mice from Srivastava et al (2017). In those files there are 76 lines. 
I want to add more lines (CC077-CC083). 
I wonder how to add  the cross information for the those new lines I'm adding? and how you get the integers (that indicate the 8 founder lines) for the lines?

Thanks you all a lot, 
Uriel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: adding cross information to cross_info file - CC mice panel
parts:
The script I used to convert the data on the other CC lines is at https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2data/blob/main/CC/R/convert_cc_data.R
I guess follow that to combine and convert the data for the other lines? 

Genotypes are converted to A/B/-. The key thing is that the codes for the lines’ genotypes need to correspond to the codes for the founders’ genotypes.

karl

We have some reference files for the CC at: https://www.jax.org/research-and-faculty/genetic-diversity-initiative/tools-data/diversity-outbred-reference-data

 

If you scroll to the bottom of the page, we have CC genotypes, genoprobs, and metadata for the lines, including funnel codes.

 

Dan
